say: They didn't fall all at once. One city got thirsty, one got scared, one got curious, one got hungry.
Read me their tablets, %1$s. I only remember them happy.
Four kingdoms, four ways to die. Desert, flood, deep, hunger. Look for what they have in common.
Every one of their ruins sits near something they drew years from. I wonder what.
They drew from the Nails, %1$s. Just like you draw through me. Do you see it yet?
Something whispered to them to draw more. It whispers to me too, sometimes. I don't answer. Yet.
